faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by Oil India Limited for filling up contractual positions at their field headquarters in Duliajan, Assam.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post announced under this notification?
faq.answer: The position announced is Retainer Doctor on Contract under advertisement number HRAQ/CONT-EX-B/26-311.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available in this recruitment?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies available for the Retainer Doctor on Contract position.

faq.question: Q4. What is the walk-in interview date for Oil India Retainer Doctor recruitment?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled to be held on 4 November 2026 with reporting time between 07:00 A.M. and 09:00 A.M.

faq.question: Q5. What is the essential educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an MBBS degree with a minimum one-year internship and a valid Certificate of Registration from MCI or SMC.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for general and reserved category candidates?
faq.answer: The minimum age is 18 years, while the maximum age limit is 45 years for General candidates and 50 years for ST candidates.

faq.question: Q7. What is the monthly salary provided for this post?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a consolidated monthly salary of ₹ 85,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for Oil India Retainer Doctor recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process consists entirely of a Walk-in-Interview carrying a total of 100 marks, assessing professional knowledge and personal skills.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any application fee required to apply?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for attending the walk-in interview.

faq.question: Q10. What documents are required to be brought for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must bring a filled Personal Bio-Data form, passport-size photographs, ID proof, address proof, educational certificates, and MCI/SMC registration certificate.
